node.statement: By node 1.1, ||Co_{P_n,Q_n}(X)-P_n(XQ_n)||<=k_co e||X||. Therefore the triangle inequality, bilinearity, submultiplicativity, ||P_n||<=B, 1+epsilon<=2, and node 1.3 give ||Co_{P_n,Q_n}(X)-X||<=k_co e||X||+||P_n(XQ_n-X)||+||P_nX-X||<=[k_co+2BL+L]e||X||. Thus C_ac:=k_co+(2B+1)L is finite and universal, while e_ac:=e_0 is positive and universal, which is exactly the asserted contract.
